details: This package is an install-time proof of concept: package.json registers a postinstall hook that runs probe.js, which performs a single HTTPS GET to hxxps://webhook[.]site/667bf650-8676-451a-8f55-b647d58825d7?source=htb-postinstall, with the callback URL itself labelling it as a HackTheBox postinstall exercise. The request carries no body, no collected data, and no host or environment metadata; the script reads no files, accesses no environment variables or tokens, and spawns no processes. Its only effect on an installer is the outbound reachability ping to that webhook[.]site callback endpoint.
